dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: So, Nam, tell me about your business. How long have you been selling lunch boxes?
dialogue.reading: soʊ, ˈnɑːm, ˈtɛl miː əˈbaʊt jʊr ˈbɪznəs. ˈhaʊ ˈlɔːŋ hæv juː bɪn ˈsɛlɪŋ ˈlʌntʃ ˈbɑːksɪz?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Since last June. My friend Ploy and I sell healthy lunch boxes to students on campus.
dialogue.reading: sɪns ˈlæst ˈdʒuːn. maɪ ˈfrɛnd ˈplɔɪ ənd aɪ ˈsɛl ˈhɛlθi ˈlʌntʃ ˈbɑːksɪz tə ˈstuːdənts ɑːn ˈkæmpəs.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Good. In June, we sold 300 boxes. In July, sales rose by 20% to 360.
dialogue.reading: ˈɡʊd. ɪn ˈdʒuːn, wiː ˈsoʊld ˈθriː ˈhʌndrəd ˈbɑːksɪz. ɪn dʒuˈlaɪ, ˈseɪlz ˈroʊz baɪ ˈtwɛnti pərˈsɛnt tə ˈθriː ˈhʌndrəd ˈsɪksti.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Did you make a profit in your first month?
dialogue.reading: dɪd juː ˈmeɪk ə ˈprɑːfɪt ɪn jʊr ˈfɜːrst ˈmʌnθ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No, we made a small loss. We had to buy a lot of equipment.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, wiː ˈmeɪd ə ˈsmɔːl ˈlɔːs. wiː ˈhæd tə ˈbaɪ ə ˈlɑːt əv ɪˈkwɪpmənt.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: That's common for a new business. And now?
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈkɑːmən fər ə ˈnuː ˈbɪznəs. ənd ˈnaʊ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Now we make a profit every month. By September, our sales had doubled to 600 boxes.
dialogue.reading: ˈnaʊ wiː ˈmeɪk ə ˈprɑːfɪt ˈɛvri ˈmʌnθ. baɪ sɛpˈtɛmbər, aʊr ˈseɪlz hæd ˈdʌbəld tə ˈsɪks ˈhʌndrəd ˈbɑːksɪz.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: That's strong growth. Did sales ever decrease?
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈstrɔːŋ ˈɡroʊθ. dɪd ˈseɪlz ˈɛvər dɪˈkriːs?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. In October, they decreased by 10% because of the midterm exams.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. ɪn ɑːkˈtoʊbər, ðeɪ dɪˈkriːst baɪ ˈtɛn pərˈsɛnt bɪˈkɔːz əv ðə ˈmɪdtɜːrm ɪɡˈzæmz.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: I see. And what's your goal for next year?
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈsiː. ənd ˈwʌts jʊr ˈɡoʊl fər ˈnɛkst ˈjɪr?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: We want our profit to increase by 50%. And maybe we can double our sales again.
dialogue.reading: wiː ˈwɑːnt aʊr ˈprɑːfɪt tu ɪnˈkriːs baɪ ˈfɪfti pərˈsɛnt. ənd ˈmeɪbi wiː kən ˈdʌbəl aʊr ˈseɪlz əˈɡɛn.
